post.description:
Rotate the session's credentials.

Refresh tokens are SINGLE-USE and rotated on EVERY successful refresh: the response always
carries a new `refresh_token` (and a new `access_token`) and the presented token is consumed.
Store both new tokens and discard the old ones. The returned token is the only valid refresh
token of the session. Presenting a consumed token is `401 INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN`: within a
short grace window (default 10 s) the session survives and the successor stays valid
(concurrent or retried requests); later reuse revokes the whole session. If the response of a
successful refresh was lost, the new token is unrecoverable: log in again. The refresh expiry
slides: `refresh_expires_at` is extended on every refresh.

get.description: The caller's own used/limit figures; nothing about objects, history or plans.

Pull the caller's changes. Protocol details: `docs/SYNC_PROTOCOL.md`.

**Bootstrap (snapshot)**: without `cursor` the server pages the CURRENT state (library items,
each followed by its `analysis.upsert` when analysis is ready, then playlists, then recent
history), not history. `mode` is `snapshot`, events have no `id`/`created_at`, `has_more` is
true until the last page, whose `next_cursor` is already a delta cursor. Pass every
`next_cursor` back unchanged.

**Delta**: with a delta cursor the response holds the events appended after it, ascending.
Poll with the last `next_cursor`; `has_more=false` means caught up.

**Cursor**: opaque, per user, durable (stays valid across restarts and deployments; there is
no expiry). The same cursor always returns the same events plus any newer ones, so a pull
may be repeated safely. Event `id`s are unique per user and never repeat; a gap in the
sequence is normal. `version` is the version of that event type's PAYLOAD SCHEMA (not an
entity revision): a type may be delivered in more than one version (`library.upsert` v1/v2).
The server never rewrites stored events; apply events in array order and idempotently.

post.description:
Upload one Track (spec 002). `multipart/form-data`, parts at most once each:

- `manifest` (required): a JSON object, schema `TrackManifest`. Send it as a plain form field or as
  a file part, UTF-8 encoded JSON, at most 64 KiB; `Content-Type: application/json` is recommended
  but the server ignores part content types and file names.
- `audio` (required): the audio file bytes (mp3, flac, m4a, ogg vorbis, ogg opus or wav).
- `artwork` (optional): the cover image bytes (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

Header `Idempotency-Key` is required. Retrying with the same key and the same content replays the
original `201` with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Identical audio content (same sanitized SHA-256) uploaded again is NOT an error: the server
reuses the stored AudioObject and still creates the new Track and library entry (`201`). There
is no "duplicate content" error code; a duplicate `track_id` is `409 TRACK_ID_CONFLICT`.
Analysis is queued server-side in the same transaction; it never fails the upload (follow
`analysis.upsert` in `GET /v1/sync`).

parameters.description: 16-128 characters of `A-Za-z0-9._:-`. One key per logical upload.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

400.description: - `INVALID_REQUEST` (retryable: false): Malformed multipart body, missing `audio`, or an unknown or duplicate part.

401.description: - `UNAUTHORIZED` (retryable: false): Missing, invalid or expired access token (refresh once, then retry).

403.description: - `STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` (retryable: false): The upload would exceed the user's storage quota. Nothing was stored.

409.description:
- `TRACK_ID_CONFLICT` (retryable: false): `track_id` already belongs to another Track (not an idempotent replay).
- `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` (retryable: false): The `Idempotency-Key` was already used for a different request.
- `INGESTION_IN_PROGRESS` (retryable: true): A request with this key is still processing; retry the same request later.

413.description:
- `AUDIO_TOO_LARGE` (retryable: false): `audio` exceeds the upload limit (100 MiB).
- `ARTWORK_TOO_LARGE` (retryable: false): `artwork` exceeds the upload limit (10 MiB).
- `REQUEST_TOO_LARGE` (retryable: false): The whole request body exceeds the edge limit.

415.description: - `UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_FORMAT` (retryable: false): Valid media, but not an accepted audio format (mp3, flac, m4a, ogg, opus, wav).

422.description:
- `INVALID_REQUEST` (retryable: false): Invalid `manifest` (`details[].loc` starts with `manifest`) or `Idempotency-Key`.
- `INVALID_AUDIO` (retryable: false): `audio` is corrupt, unreadable or not audio.
- `AUDIO_TOO_LONG` (retryable: false): Audio duration exceeds the limit (1200 s).
- `INVALID_ARTWORK` (retryable: false): `artwork` is invalid, unsupported (JPEG, PNG, WebP only) or too large in pixels.

429.description: - `RATE_LIMITED` (retryable: true): Too many ingestion requests; wait for `Retry-After` seconds.

500.description:
- `SANITIZATION_FAILED` (retryable: false): Media could not be sanitized; resending the same file will not help.
- `INTERNAL_ERROR` (retryable: false): Unexpected server error.

503.description:
- `STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` (retryable: true): Object storage is temporarily unavailable; retry with the same key.
- `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (retryable: true): A dependency (database) is temporarily unavailable; retry.
